qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Long-term university nomination agreements and scarce on-campus planning permissions provide high occupancy (98%+) and 5-7% annual rent growth.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 4 (CAP = 5, REJECT). UK purpose-built student accommodation faces severe structural headwinds from UK international student visa restrictions (dependent bans) and widespread UK university sector financial deficits, capping predictable runway < 15 years.
qualitative.evidence: PBSA leader in UK, but university sector faces severe structural deficits and government visa policies led to ~15% contraction in sponsored international study visas, impairing non-Russell Group demand.
